# Upgrade fixtures: C4X 1.8.0

What a 1.8.0 user already has, used by `src/__tests__/upgrade/upgrade-1.8.0.test.ts` and
`test/suite/upgrade-1.8.0.test.ts` (#366). Never regenerate these from current code.

Regenerate the machine-produced files with `scripts/generate-upgrade-fixtures.ts` (usage in its
header); a re-run reproduces them byte for byte. They were generated by running the 1.8.0 modules from a temporary worktree of the `v1.8.0` tag (outside
this repository, removed afterwards), with the repository's `vscode` unit mock and its
`node_modules`:

| File | How it was produced |
|---|---|
| `draft-state.json` | `serializeDraftState` from `src/webview/previewClientScript.ts` at `v1.8.0`, given two staged edits (a move with a label and a connect relationship, a description and tag edit), a selection and a camera. This is what the webview passes to `vscode.setState`. |
| `workspace-state.json` | `saveBinding` from `src/webview/editorBinding.ts` at `v1.8.0`, recorded against a fake Memento, once for a native diagram and once for a Markdown block. |
| `sidecar/.c4x-layout.json` | `saveSidecarLayout` from `src/writeback/SidecarPersistence.ts` at `v1.8.0` against an in-memory file: four saves across two diagrams, then `locked: true` added to one entry (no 1.8.0 save path writes it) and one more save to let 1.8.0 serialise the file. |
| `themes.json` | The five theme objects (`C4StandardTheme`, `ClassicTheme`, `ModernTheme`, `MutedTheme`, `HighContrastTheme`) loaded from `src/themes` at `v1.8.0` and serialised. `auto` is generated at run time and is not captured. |
| `manifest-contributes.json` | Extracted from `git show v1.8.0:package.json`: contributed commands, keybindings, language ids, grammar scopes, activation events and every setting with its type, default, enum and range. `registeredCommands` is every `registerCommand('...')` id in `src/` at the tag (19, multi-line registrations included), `keybindings` keep their `when` clause. |
| `user-settings.json`, `workspace-settings.json` | Hand-built. The seeds `test/runTest.ts` copies into the upgrade launch's user settings and temporary workspace before the extension first activates: one unknown `c4x.theme` value, and an unrelated workspace setting. |
| `settings.json` | Hand-built. The `c4x.theme` values a 1.8.0 user can hold (enum at `package.json:283-292`, `c4-standard` from the picker, the fallback at `src/themes/ThemeManager.ts:39`) and a value for each other setting. |
| `secret-storage.json` | Hand-built from the 1.8.0 source, with file and line in its `_comment`. |

Note: the extension keeps its draft in the webview's own state, so a draft cannot be seeded from
the host. The tests run the real on-load code of the webview script against `draft-state.json`.
